name: Couch Stretch with Reachovers
instructions: Kneel facing away from a couch or bench and place one foot up against it behind you.
Step the other foot forward into a lunge position, torso upright.
Squeeze your back glute and tuck your pelvis slightly.
Reach the arm on the back-leg side overhead and lean gently away.
Hold 20 to 30 seconds, then switch sides.
longevityNotes: Mobility is use-it-or-lose-it. Ten minutes of daily joint work preserves the ranges that keep you independent — reaching, bending, and getting up from the floor.
overview: A deep hip-flexor and quad stretch with an overhead reach that adds a side stretch through the torso.
